verdict.rationale: Jan exposes an OpenAI-compatible local API server (jan-gh-4, jan-docs-6) which lets developers reuse existing OpenAI SDKs, but there is no evidence of a dedicated first-party Jan SDK, and probes for a published OpenAPI/swagger spec or docs.md all returned 404s, suggesting thin formal API documentation for builders. missing for 10: dedicated official SDK packages, published OpenAPI spec, and independent developer corroboration of building against the API.
